title: Sun-Lane Crossing
description: Aten Ra advances through open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and formation answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles

objectives.primary: Shatter corrupted obelisk anchors before they finish darkening the route.
optional: Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

specialRules: Sunflare Tiles: marked tiles flare after one turn.
River Push: light channels slide units one tile if they end exposed.
victoryConditions: Shatter corrupted obelisk anchors before they finish darkening the route.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
